snippet.title: Hell is Other Demons - Release Date Announcement Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10016120

Hell is Other Demons is coming to PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4 in October 29th! Crank you Halloween up to 11 with one of the best hardcore roguelikes of this generation!

“A Bullet Hell Set In Hell That's Heaven To Play”
Kotaku

“While some games use aesthetic to hide poorly considered gameplay, Hell is Other Demons has nothing to hide. It’s a simple concept, but it’s executed flawlessly.”
4.5/5 – Game Revolution

“Hell Is Other Demons goes the distance in its refined and frantic gameplay that captures the nostalgia of 8-bit arcade shooters.”
8/10 – Cultured Vultures

#ps5 #ps5games #ps4 #ps4games
